title: 第25章 坏三闹事第26章 教训坏三
content_zh:
“叶开，快点跟上！”王艳拉着叶开追出来。
“我跟她去干什么？”
“打铁趁热，赶紧拿下她！”
“我拿下她干什么？”
“当媳妇啊！”王艳打开车门，将叶开塞进车里。
事情紧急，陈曼也来不及和叶开说话，发动了小车，一路疾驶来到桃花镇医院。
医院大门前，站着一帮穿花衬衫戴墨镜的青年，他们用竹竿打着横幅，上写：“无良医生害我一生性福”。
领头的是一个染着金色头发的青年，此人叫坏三，是桃花镇一霸。
坏三带头喊道：“叫陈曼出来说话！”
张怀涛带着几名医生护士，还有保安，和坏三一帮人对峙。
张怀涛警告坏三：“这里是医院，坏三，你们不要在这里闹事，要是再不走，我就报警了！”
坏三根本不害怕，“你报呀，最好你叫警察来把我和陈曼一起抓走。
明天你们医院就上头条了，你们这里的医生水平太菜了，我被她治的失去了男性功能，你说怎么办吧？”
“你怎么证明是陈医生把你治的失去男性功能了？”
“这还要怎么证明？我之前好好的，自从吃了她开的药，回到家里就不行了。”
一个女护士很不服气地说：“谁知道你原来行还是不行！”
坏三打量着女护士，一张瓜子脸长的还不错，穿着白大褂，身材倒也蛮标致。
坏三动了坏心思，一脸坏笑地说：“你要是不信，咱们可以试一试，不过你这么漂亮，说不定跟你我就行了呢！”
几个青年跟着起哄：“对呀，你跟三哥试一试！”
“这妞正点，说不定能治好三哥的病！”

护士的脸红了，啐道：“呸！臭流氓！狗嘴里吐不出象牙。”
“哈哈哈！”坏三一帮人哈哈大笑。
“兄弟们，拍照！”坏三带头拿出手机对着医院拍起来。
“发朋友圈，让大家都来转发！“
“发到投条上，曝光这家医院！”
“发到豆音上，让世界人民看一看，无良医生是怎么害人的！”
张怀涛呵斥道：“你们想干什么，不准拍照！”
“再拍照，我就让警察来抓你们！”
坏三猖狂地说：“来呀，你看看在桃花镇，谁敢动老子！”
坏三之所以这么嚣张，是有原因的。
他开赌场、游戏厅、舞厅，和一帮警察混的很熟，就连派出所所长都经常去他店里玩，和他称兄道弟。
他手下几十号兄弟，谁敢得罪他，就让这些小弟轮番骚扰。
今天把你车子轮胎扎了，明天把你家孙子从学校接走，在镇上玩一圈，先让你惊吓一通，再把孩子送上门。
美其名曰，学雷锋做好人好事。
胆小的、心脏不好的被吓了个半死，还拿他没办法。
桃花镇没人敢招惹坏三这帮人，大家躲都来不及。
只听一声娇叱：“坏三，你想干什么？”
陈曼来到坏三面前，
坏三一看，“陈医生，你终于出现了，你这两天躲哪去了？”
“我干嘛躲你，我家里有事，请假了。”

“你心里有鬼，你把我治残废了，你说怎么赔我？”
content_en:
"Ye Kai, hurry up and follow!" Wang Yan pulled Ye Kai and chased him out.
"What should I do with her?"
"Strike while the iron is hot and capture her quickly!"
"Why should I take her?"
"Be a wife!" Wang Yan opened the car door and put Ye Kai into the car.
The matter was urgent, and Chen Man didn't have time to talk to Ye Kai, so he started the car and drove all the way to Taohua Town Hospital.
In front of the hospital gate, a group of young people wearing floral shirts and sunglasses stood. They held a banner with a bamboo pole that read: "Unscrupulous doctors ruined my sexual happiness throughout my life."
The leader is a young man with dyed blond hair. This person is called Bad San and he is the tyrant of Peach Blossom Town.
Bad San took the lead and shouted: "Tell Chen Man to come out and speak!"
Zhang Huaitao took several doctors, nurses, and security guards to confront the Bad Trinity gang.
Zhang Huaitao warned Badan: "This is a hospital, Badan. Don't make trouble here. If you don't leave, I will call the police!"
Bad San was not afraid at all, "You report it, you'd better call the police to arrest me and Chen Man together.
Your hospital will make headlines tomorrow. The doctors here are so bad. I lost my male function due to her treatment. What do you think I should do? "
"How do you prove that Dr. Chen treated you to the point where you lost your male function?"
"How can we prove this? I was fine before, but since I took the medicine she prescribed, I can't do it anymore when I get home."
A female nurse said unconvincedly: "Who knows whether you can do it or not!"
Bad San looked at the female nurse. She had a pretty face and a pretty face. She was wearing a white coat and had a pretty figure.
Bad San had a bad idea and said with a wicked smile: "If you don't believe it, we can give it a try, but you are so beautiful, maybe I can do it with you!"
Several young people followed and shouted: "Yes, you and third brother give it a try!"
"This girl is on point, maybe she can cure Third Brother's disease!"
The nurse blushed and spat: "Bah! You rascal! A dog can't spit out ivory from its mouth."
"Hahaha!" The Bad Trinity gang laughed.
"Brothers, take pictures!" Bad San took the lead and took out his mobile phone to take pictures of the hospital.
“Post it to Moments and let everyone forward it!”
"Send it to the forum to expose this hospital!"
"Post it on Douyin so that people around the world can see how unscrupulous doctors harm people!"
Zhang Huaitao scolded: "What do you want to do? You are not allowed to take pictures!"
"If you take more pictures, I will ask the police to arrest you!"
Bad San said arrogantly: "Come on, look at who dares to touch me in Peach Blossom Town!"
There is a reason why Bad San is so arrogant.
He opened a casino, game arcade, and dance hall, and became very familiar with a group of policemen. Even the police station director often went to his store to play and became brothers with him.
He has dozens of brothers. Anyone who dares to offend him will be harassed by these younger brothers in turn.
Today I punctured the tires of your car, and tomorrow I pick up your grandson from school, play around in the town, scare you first, and then send the child to your door.
The euphemistic name is, learn from Lei Feng and do good deeds.
The timid one with a weak heart was frightened half to death, and there was nothing he could do.
No one in Peach Blossom Town dared to provoke Bad San and his gang, and it was too late for everyone to hide.
Only a scolding sound was heard: "Bao San, what do you want to do?"
Chen Man came to Bad San,
Bad Sanyi looked at him and said, "Dr. Chen, you finally showed up. Where have you been hiding these past two days?"
"Why should I hide from you? I have something to do at home and I'm asking for leave."
"You have something in your mind. You disabled me. How do you plan to compensate me?"
